title: Natick Select Board quashes Flock license plate reader pilot; Police chief apologizes & explains - Natick Report
summary: The Natick (MA) Select Board voted unanimously to end a Flock Safety license plate reader pilot that had been launched by the Police Department without board notification, and to form a working group to study the technology. Police Chief James Hicks apologized for the lack of public notice and defended the technology's investigative value, while board members and residents raised privacy, surveillance, and data-sharing concerns.
